tasks.title: Implement Chunking Strategies
tasks.description: Create text chunking implementations in src/qdrant_indexer/chunkers.py with recursive character splitting as the primary strategy.
tasks.details:
1. Create abstract base Chunker class with chunk(text: str) -> List[str] method
2. Implement RecursiveChunker (primary strategy):
   - Parameters: chunk_size (default 512), overlap (default 50)
   - Split hierarchy: \n\n (paragraphs) -> \n (lines) -> . (sentences) -> space (words)
   - Ensure chunks don't exceed chunk_size
   - Maintain overlap between consecutive chunks for context continuity
3. Implement FixedSizeChunker (simple alternative):
   - Split text into fixed-size chunks with overlap
   - No semantic awareness
4. Create helper functions:
   - split_text_with_overlap(text, size, overlap)
   - merge_small_chunks(chunks, min_size)
5. Consider adding SemanticChunker placeholder for future enhancement

This provides the foundation for all chunking strategy implementations and ensures a consistent interface across different chunking approaches.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify that the abstract class cannot be instantiated directly and that concrete implementations must implement the chunk() method

subtasks.title: Implement RecursiveChunker with hierarchical splitting
subtasks.description: Create RecursiveChunker class with recursive text splitting using paragraph, line, sentence, and word boundaries
subtasks.details:
Implement RecursiveChunker(Chunker) with:
- Constructor parameters: chunk_size (default 512), overlap (default 50)
- Implement chunk() method with split hierarchy:
  1. First try splitting by '\n\n' (paragraphs)
  2. If chunks too large, split by '\n' (lines)
  3. If still too large, split by '. ' (sentences)
  4. Finally split by space (words) as last resort
- Ensure no chunk exceeds chunk_size
- Maintain overlap between consecutive chunks for context continuity
- Handle edge cases: empty text, text smaller than chunk_size
- Add logic to recursively process chunks that are still too large
- Return list of text chunks with proper overlap
subtasks.testStrategy: Test with various text lengths, verify chunk sizes stay within limits, verify overlap is maintained, test each split level (paragraphs, lines, sentences, words)

subtasks.title: Implement FixedSizeChunker as simple alternative
subtasks.description: Create FixedSizeChunker class for basic fixed-size text splitting without semantic awareness
subtasks.details:
Implement FixedSizeChunker(Chunker) with:
- Constructor parameters: chunk_size (default 512), overlap (default 50)
- Implement chunk() method that:
  1. Splits text into fixed-size chunks based on chunk_size
  2. Applies overlap by including the last 'overlap' characters from previous chunk
  3. Handles edge cases: empty text, text smaller than chunk_size
- No semantic awareness - purely character-based splitting
- Return list of text chunks with specified overlap
This provides a simpler, faster alternative when semantic boundaries are not important.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test with various text lengths, verify exact chunk sizes, verify overlap calculations, test edge cases like empty text and small text

subtasks.title: Implement helper functions for chunk processing
subtasks.description: Create utility functions for text splitting with overlap and merging small chunks
subtasks.details:

   - Generic function to split text into chunks of given size

2. merge_small_chunks(chunks: List[str], min_size: int) -> List[str]:

subtasks.title: Implement index_file method for single file processing
subtasks.description: Create index_file() method that loads, chunks, embeds, and uploads a single file to Qdrant with proper metadata
subtasks.details:
Implement index_file(self, file_path: Path, chunker: Chunker, batch_size: int = 100) -> int method:
- Import get_loader from loaders module to get appropriate loader for file type
- Load document: loader = get_loader(file_path); doc = loader.load(file_path)
- Chunk content: chunks = chunker.chunk(doc.content)
- For each chunk with index i:
  - Generate embedding: vector = list(self.embeddings.embed([chunk])[0])
  - Create point ID using hashlib: point_id = hash(f"{file_path}-{i}") & 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFF (ensure positive int64)
  - Build payload dict with: text=chunk, source=str(file_path), chunk_index=i, total_chunks=len(chunks), timestamp=datetime.now().isoformat(), **doc.metadata
  - Append to batch list
- Batch upload when len(batch) >= batch_size using self.client.upsert()
- Upload remaining batch if any
- Return total number of chunks processed
- Add comprehensive error handling and logging
subtasks.testStrategy: Test with sample files of different types, verify correct number of points created, verify point IDs are consistent and positive, verify payloads contain all required fields, test batch uploading logic

subtasks.title: Implement index_directory method with file discovery
subtasks.description: Create index_directory() method that discovers files matching patterns and indexes them in batches with progress reporting
subtasks.details:
Implement index_directory(self, path: Path, pattern: str = "**/*.{md,rst,txt,pdf}", chunker: Chunker = None, batch_size: int = 100) -> dict method:
- If chunker is None, create default: from chunkers import RecursiveChunker; chunker = RecursiveChunker()
- Use path.glob(pattern) to find all matching files
- Initialize counters: total_files=0, total_chunks=0, failed_files=[]
- For each file_path in matching files:
  - Try: chunks_count = self.index_file(file_path, chunker, batch_size)
  - Update total_files += 1 and total_chunks += chunks_count
  - Print progress: f"Processed {file_path.name}: {chunks_count} chunks"
  - Except: log error and append to failed_files
- Return summary dict with: {"total_files": total_files, "total_chunks": total_chunks, "failed_files": failed_files}
- Add docstring with parameter explanations and return value description
- Consider using rich.progress for better progress reporting in future enhancement
subtasks.testStrategy: Test with directory containing multiple file types, verify all matching files are processed, verify pattern matching works correctly, test error handling with invalid files, verify summary statistics are accurate

subtasks.title: Add helper methods for point ID generation and payload building
subtasks.description: Extract point ID generation and payload building into reusable helper methods with proper validation
subtasks.details:
Add helper methods to QdrantIndexer class:
1. _generate_point_id(self, file_path: Path, chunk_index: int) -> int:
   - Create stable hash from f"{file_path}-{chunk_index}"
   - Use hashlib.sha256 for better distribution than built-in hash
   - Convert to int64 and ensure positive: int.from_bytes(hash_obj.digest()[:8], 'big') & 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
   - Return the point ID
2. _build_payload(self, chunk: str, file_path: Path, chunk_index: int, total_chunks: int, metadata: dict) -> dict:
   - Create payload dict with required fields: text, source, chunk_index, total_chunks, timestamp
   - Merge with additional metadata from document loader
   - Validate that text is not empty and source path is valid
   - Return validated payload dict
3. Refactor index_file() to use these helper methods for cleaner code
- Add comprehensive docstrings for both helper methods
- Make methods private with leading underscore since they're internal utilities
subtasks.testStrategy: Test _generate_point_id produces consistent IDs for same inputs, test IDs are always positive int64, test _build_payload creates valid payload structure, verify all required fields are present, test with various metadata combinations

subtasks.title: Implement 'index' command with all options
subtasks.description: Create the main index command that indexes a directory into a Qdrant collection with support for chunking, pattern matching, and batch processing
subtasks.details:
Implement @app.command() decorated function index() with:
- Required argument: path: Path (directory to index)
- Options:
  * --collection: str (required, collection name)
  * --url: str (default="http://localhost:6333", Qdrant server URL)
  * --chunk-size: int (default=512, chunk size in characters)
  * --chunk-overlap: int (default=50, overlap between chunks)
  * --pattern: str (default="**/*.{md,rst,txt,pdf}", glob pattern for files)
  * --batch-size: int (default=100, batch size for uploads)
  * --exclude: List[str] (default=None, patterns to exclude)
- Logic:
  1. Validate path exists and is a directory
  2. Create QdrantIndexer instance with url and collection
  3. Call ensure_collection() to create collection if needed
  4. Create RecursiveChunker with chunk_size and chunk_overlap
  5. Call index_directory() with path, pattern, chunker, batch_size
  6. Use rich Console to display progress and results
  7. Show summary: files processed, chunks created, time elapsed
- Error handling: wrap in try/except, display helpful error messages with rich
- Add comprehensive docstring with parameter descriptions and usage examples
subtasks.testStrategy: Test with sample directory, verify all options work correctly, test error handling with invalid paths, verify chunking parameters are passed correctly, check rich output formatting

subtasks.title: Implement 'delete-collection' command with confirmation
subtasks.description: Create command to delete a Qdrant collection with safety confirmation prompt to prevent accidental deletions
subtasks.details:
Implement @app.command(name="delete-collection") decorated function delete_collection() with:
- Required argument: collection: str (name of collection to delete)
- Options:
  * --url: str (default="http://localhost:6333", Qdrant server URL)
  * --yes / -y: bool (default=False, skip confirmation prompt)
- Logic:
  1. Create QdrantClient instance with url
  2. Check if collection exists with client.collection_exists(collection)
  3. If not exists, display error message and exit
  4. If --yes flag not provided:
     - Use typer.confirm(f"Are you sure you want to delete collection '{collection}'?", abort=True)
     - This will abort execution if user declines
  5. Call client.delete_collection(collection)
  6. Display success message with rich console: "✓ Deleted collection '{collection}'"
- Error handling:
  * Catch collection not found errors
  * Handle connection errors
  * Display clear error messages with typer.echo()
- Add warning styling to confirmation prompt using rich
- Add docstring with safety warnings

This ensures users don't accidentally delete important collections without confirmation.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test confirmation prompt behavior, verify --yes flag bypasses prompt, test with non-existent collection, verify successful deletion, test abort behavior when user declines

subtasks.title: Set up pytest infrastructure and dev dependencies
subtasks.description: Add pytest and pytest-cov to pyproject.toml dev dependencies and create the tests/ directory structure with __init__.py
subtasks.details:
1. Add pytest>=8.0.0 and pytest-cov>=4.1.0 to [project.optional-dependencies] dev section in pyproject.toml
2. Create tests/ directory in project root
3. Create tests/__init__.py file (can be empty)
4. Run 'uv sync --extra dev' to install dev dependencies
5. Verify pytest is installed by running 'pytest --version'

This establishes the testing infrastructure needed for all subsequent test files. The directory structure follows Python testing best practices with tests/ as a top-level directory parallel to src/.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify pytest can be run from project root with 'pytest tests/', even with no tests yet. Check that pytest-cov is available for coverage reporting.

subtasks.title: Create test fixtures and conftest.py with sample documents
subtasks.description: Set up pytest fixtures in tests/conftest.py with sample documents for each supported file format (Markdown, Text, PDF, RST) and mock Qdrant client
subtasks.details:
Create tests/conftest.py with fixtures:
1. @pytest.fixture sample_markdown_content: Returns markdown text with frontmatter (---\ntitle: Test\nauthor: Tester\n---\n# Header\nContent)
2. @pytest.fixture sample_markdown_file(tmp_path): Creates temporary .md file and returns Path
3. @pytest.fixture sample_text_file(tmp_path): Creates .txt file with plain text
4. @pytest.fixture sample_pdf_file(tmp_path): Creates simple PDF using pymupdf (optional - can mock instead)
5. @pytest.fixture sample_rst_file(tmp_path): Creates .rst file with ReStructuredText
6. @pytest.fixture mock_qdrant_client: Returns MagicMock configured for QdrantClient with mock methods (collection_exists, create_collection, upsert)
7. @pytest.fixture sample_long_text: Returns text string ~2000 chars for chunking tests
8. @pytest.fixture sample_document: Returns Document instance with sample metadata

These fixtures will be reused across all test modules, providing consistent test data and reducing duplication.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify all fixtures can be imported and used in test files. Test that temporary files are properly created and cleaned up. Verify mock_qdrant_client has expected methods.

subtasks.title: Write comprehensive loader tests in test_loaders.py

subtasks.details:

1. TestMarkdownLoader:

2. TestTextLoader:

   - test_text_loader_metadata: Check filename, size, mtime in metadata

3. TestPDFLoader:
   - test_load_pdf_extracts_text: Verify text extraction from pages
   - test_pdf_metadata_includes_pages: Check page numbers in metadata
   - test_pdf_file_invalid: Test error handling for corrupt PDF

4. TestReStructuredTextLoader:
   - test_load_rst_file: Verify RST content loaded
   - test_rst_metadata_extraction: Test any directive metadata

5. TestLoaderFactory:
   - test_get_loader_for_markdown: Verify .md returns MarkdownLoader
   - test_get_loader_for_pdf: Verify .pdf returns PDFLoader
   - test_get_loader_default_unknown_extension: Verify unknown returns TextLoader

8. Verify Document objects have correct structure (content, metadata, source_path)
subtasks.testStrategy: Run pytest tests/test_loaders.py with coverage. Aim for >90% coverage of loaders.py. Verify all loader classes and factory function work correctly.

subtasks.title: Write comprehensive chunker tests in test_chunkers.py
subtasks.description: Create tests/test_chunkers.py to test RecursiveChunker and FixedSizeChunker with various text sizes, chunk size limits, overlap verification, and edge cases
subtasks.details:
Create tests/test_chunkers.py with comprehensive test coverage:

1. TestRecursiveChunker:
   - test_chunks_respect_size_limit: Assert all chunks <= chunk_size
   - test_chunks_maintain_overlap: Verify overlap chars match between consecutive chunks
   - test_empty_text_returns_empty_list: Edge case for empty string
   - test_text_smaller_than_chunk_size: Verify single chunk returned
   - test_paragraph_splitting: Text with \n\n should split at paragraphs first
   - test_sentence_splitting: If no paragraphs, should split at periods
   - test_word_splitting_fallback: Very long lines should split at spaces
   - test_overlap_parameter: Test with different overlap values (0, 25, 100)
   - test_large_document_chunking: Use sample_long_text fixture, verify chunk count
   - test_chunk_size_boundary_conditions: Test edge cases like chunk_size=1

2. TestFixedSizeChunker:
   - test_fixed_chunks_exact_size: Verify chunks are exactly chunk_size (except last)
   - test_fixed_overlap_calculation: Verify overlap is correctly applied
   - test_no_overlap_mode: Test with overlap=0
   - test_text_smaller_than_chunk: Should return single chunk
   - test_empty_text_fixed: Edge case handling

3. TestHelperFunctions (if implemented):
   - test_split_text_with_overlap: Test helper function independently
   - test_merge_small_chunks: Verify small chunks are merged correctly

4. Use parametrized tests (@pytest.mark.parametrize) for testing multiple chunk_size and overlap combinations
5. Test both ASCII and Unicode text to ensure proper character handling
6. Verify no data loss - all text from original should appear in chunks
subtasks.testStrategy: Run pytest tests/test_chunkers.py with coverage. Aim for >95% coverage of chunkers.py. Use parametrize for thorough testing of different configurations. Verify chunk sizes and overlaps mathematically.

subtasks.title: Write indexer tests with mocked Qdrant in test_indexer.py
subtasks.description: Create tests/test_indexer.py to test QdrantIndexer with mocked Qdrant client, covering collection creation, point generation, batch uploading, and the full indexing pipeline
subtasks.details:
Create tests/test_indexer.py with comprehensive mocking:

1. TestQdrantIndexerInit:
   - test_indexer_initialization: Verify QdrantClient and TextEmbedding created
   - test_indexer_custom_embedding_model: Test with different model

2. TestEnsureCollection:
   - test_collection_exists_not_created: Mock collection_exists=True, verify create not called
   - test_collection_not_exists_created: Mock collection_exists=False, verify create_collection called with correct vector config (size=384, distance=Cosine)

3. TestIndexFile:
   - test_index_single_file_creates_points: Use sample_markdown_file, verify points generated
   - test_point_id_generation_consistent: Same file should generate same IDs
   - test_point_payload_structure: Verify payload has text, source, chunk_index, total_chunks, timestamp
   - test_file_metadata_included_in_payload: Verify document metadata merged into payload
   - test_batch_upload_triggered: Mock upsert, verify called when batch_size reached
   - test_remaining_batch_uploaded: Verify final batch uploaded even if < batch_size
   - test_returns_chunk_count: Verify index_file returns correct number of chunks

4. TestIndexDirectory:
   - test_index_multiple_files(tmp_path): Create multiple test files, verify all processed
   - test_pattern_matching: Test glob patterns filter files correctly
   - test_failed_files_tracked: Mock file that raises error, verify in failed_files list
   - test_summary_statistics: Verify returned dict has total_files, total_chunks, failed_files
   - test_default_chunker_used: Verify RecursiveChunker created if None passed

5. TestHelperMethods:
   - test_generate_point_id_consistency: Same input produces same ID
   - test_generate_point_id_positive: All IDs are positive int64
   - test_build_payload_required_fields: Verify all required fields present
   - test_build_payload_merges_metadata: Verify custom metadata included

6. Use mock_qdrant_client fixture from conftest.py
7. Mock TextEmbedding.embed() to return fake vectors (list of 384 floats)
8. Use unittest.mock.patch or pytest-mock for mocking
9. Verify embedding generation is called with correct chunk text
10. Test error handling and edge cases
subtasks.testStrategy: Run pytest tests/test_indexer.py with coverage. Aim for >90% coverage of indexer.py. Mock all external dependencies (Qdrant, FastEmbed). Verify integration between loaders, chunkers, and indexer. Use caplog to verify logging output.

tasks.title: Implement File Filtering and Exclusion
tasks.description: Add support for glob patterns to include/exclude files during indexing, with sensible defaults.
tasks.details:
1. Add --pattern option for include patterns (default: "**/*.{md,rst,txt}")
2. Add --exclude option for exclude patterns
3. Default exclusions:
   - node_modules/**
   - **/.git/**
   - **/__pycache__/**
   - **/*.pyc
   - **/venv/**
   - **/.venv/**
4. Support multiple --exclude flags
5. Use pathlib and fnmatch for pattern matching
6. Respect .gitignore if present (optional enhancement)
7. Log which files are being skipped and why (in verbose mode)
